description: Extract RAG-ready document rows from every file in a Google Drive folder, any type (PDFs, Google Sheets, Google Slides, Google Docs, uploaded .docx/.pptx/.xlsx/images), via a service account. Native Google formats are exported (Docs/Slides -> text/plain, Sheets -> text/csv); everything else is downloaded and routed through pdfplumber/python-docx/BeautifulSoup/markitdown.
summary: Extract RAG-ready document rows from every file in a Google Drive folder.

outputs.description: One row per file with the document source contract: doc_id, content, title, url, source_type, updated_at, content_hash.

credentials.description: Service account credentials as a dict. Set this OR credentials_path OR rely on GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.
credentials.label: Credentials (dict)

credentials_path.label: Credentials Path
credentials_path.description: Path to service-account JSON. Falls back to GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.

drive_folder_id.label: Drive Folder Id
drive_folder_id.description: Google Drive folder ID to read every file from (any type -- PDFs, Google Sheets, Google Slides, uploaded .docx/.pptx/.xlsx/images/etc). The folder itself IS the source (like document_corpus/document_ingestion's own source_dir) -- there is no upstream_asset_key mode here.

recursive.label: Recursive
recursive.description: Also walk subfolders (discovered via mimeType='application/vnd.google-apps.folder' entries in the same listing call) and extract files found inside them. Default False: only the immediate contents of drive_folder_id, matching this repo's non-recursive-by-default convention for Drive/cloud folder listings.

include_trashed.label: Include Trashed
include_trashed.description: Include trashed files in the listing.

max_files.label: Max Files
max_files.description: Stop after this many files total (across all subfolders if recursive) -- avoids accidental full-Drive scans.

download_max_bytes.label: Download Max Bytes
download_max_bytes.description: Skip non-native (uploaded) files larger than this before downloading. Default 10 MB. Native Google-format exports have no `size` field and are instead bounded by the Drive API's own ~10MB export cap.

rate_limit_delay.label: Rate Limit Delay
rate_limit_delay.description: Seconds to sleep between per-file export/download calls.

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog. Defaults to ['google', 'drive', 'rag', 'documents'] when unset.
kinds.label: Kinds

column_lineage.label: Column Lineage
column_lineage.description: Column-level lineage, emitted as `dagster/column_lineage` metadata on every materialization: {output column: [upstream columns]}. The upstream asset is the only entry of `deps` (there is no upstream_asset_key here). Ignored with a warning when no upstream asset can be resolved.

partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', 'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition. 0 (the Dagster default) means a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows -- e.g. a daily set never includes today until tomorrow. Set to 1 to include the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition (defaults to UTC when unset, matching Dagster's own default).

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'customer_a,customer_b,customer_c'.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions

partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter the returned DataFrame to the current date partition (time partitions). E.g. 'updated_at'.
partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column

partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter the returned DataFrame to the current static/dynamic partition key.
partition_static_column.label: Partition Static Column

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include a markdown preview of the fetched rows in the materialization metadata.

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Max rows to include in the preview when include_preview_metadata is True.

name: Google Drive Documents
